packageRules.description: Treat pre-1.0 dprint/oxfmt (stable formatters) as non-major so bumps group with other deps; regroups normally once they reach 1.0.0+.

Hold conventional-changelog-conventionalcommits on v9: @semantic-release/release-notes-generator@14 bundles the Handlebars conventional-changelog-writer@8, and preset v10's function-based templates render empty release notes under writer@8. Drop once release-notes-generator ships a writer@9 major.

Hold eslint on v9 in the Next.js templates only: eslint-config-next (vendored Babel parser + eslint-plugin-react@7.37.5) isn't ESLint-10-ready, so `next lint`/`eslint .` crash in both the JS and TS Next.js templates. Tracked at https://github.com/vercel/next.js/issues/91702. Drop once that ships and eslint-config-next is bumped past it.
